new.example_sushi: Minimalist sushi bar: lots of white space, black and vermilion, clean sans-serif font, large square photos.
new.example_cafe: Bright Scandinavian café: pastel colours, rounded cards, friendly font, cakes and coffee highlighted with photos.
new.example_steakhouse: Upscale steakhouse: near-black background, gold accents, elegant serif font, large images, right-aligned prices.
new.example_vegan: Fresh vegan restaurant: lots of green, natural tones, modern font, tags like vegan and gluten-free clearly visible.
new.example_biergarten: Bavarian beer garden: blue and white, rustic wood feel, bold headings, drinks featured prominently.
